chunks: My scholars narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Ahmad ibn Abi Zahir, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Sayf ibn 'Amirah, from al-'Is ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali, who said:
I asked Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Is it obligatory to perform Ghusl for the one who visits al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He replied, 'No.'
ai.seo_question: Is Ghusl obligatory before visiting Imam Husayn's shrine?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) clarifies that while ritual purity is commendable, the full ritual bath (Ghusl) is not a strict legal obligation (wajib) for performing Ziyarah to Imam al-Husayn (a.s.). This ruling alleviates the burden on pilgrims, emphasizing that the spiritual merit of the visit relies more on intention and reverence than on rigid ritualistic prerequisites, a key principle in Shia jurisprudence regarding devotional acts.
